sections.Profile:
The "Race-Way" pinball machine, produced by Midway Manufacturing Co. in 1963, is a two-player electro-mechanical game that simulates auto racing. A standout feature is its animated backbox, which showcases two die-cast cars racing around a track, advancing based on player actions. The playfield includes two flippers, four slingshots, seven hanging targets, and four kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Midway Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1963–1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Racing, Sports, Original Theme, Widebody, Cars
